role: The integrated server's handshake handler: it switches the in-memory connection's protocol state to LOGIN or STATUS and hands LOGIN to NetHandlerLoginServer.
scope_reason: Wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes) (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).
missing: The in-memory join handshake (the protocol state switch to LOGIN, then NetHandlerLoginServer) is not ported: the native replay reconstructs the join from the snapshot and never runs a protocol state machine.
notes: Reached at every Java join (the client connects to the integrated server over the in-memory channel), but it carries no game state: its observable effect is the join itself, which the native replay produces through serverreplay.c's login replay.
